summary: Special repairs and maintenance (civil works) at the Minicoy (South) Lighthouse Station, Minicoy, Lakshadweep, tendered by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

scope.item: Special repairs and maintenance of Minicoy (South) Lighthouse Station (details in tender document on CPPP; no BOQ in this notice)

money.notes: EMD by Demand Draft/FDR in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) to be submitted physically. Bid Securing Declaration listed among required documents.

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous bodies; OR, for contractors from Lakshadweep, work experience with any Government department during last 7 years in island works
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two works each >= 50%, or one work >= 80%
Similar works: construction or repair and maintenance of building/road/CC pathway/lighthouse tower or other civil construction works
Annual turnover of last three years certified by Chartered Accountant
Declaration that bid is unconditional; affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper of not being blacklisted
Undertaking listing relatives serving as Gazetted/Account Officers in MoPSW or DGLL
Copy of EPF/labour registration certificate; Tender Acceptance Letter; Bid Securing Declaration
